# soulintension

> soulintension is a Side B Christian community in Sonoma County, California, for LGBT people and their allies who want to explore faith in Jesus honestly. Side B holds a traditional Christian sexual ethic while fully affirming the dignity, humanity, and belonging of LGBT people.

soulintension is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit ministry. It runs a mid-week gathering in the Santa Rosa area and publishes resources on faith and sexuality. It is not a church and does not replace one, and nobody is required to hold a Side B view to belong.

## Key definitions
- Side B: following Jesus with a traditional sexual ethic (marriage between a man and a woman) while fully affirming the dignity and belonging of LGBT people.
- Side A: affirms same-sex marriage and relationships as consistent with Christian faith.
- Side X: the view that same-sex attraction should be resisted or changed. soulintension is not a Side X space and is not a debate forum.

- [FAQ](https://www.soulintension.com/faq): answers about Side B Christianity, Side A vs Side B, celibacy, affirming theology, and soulintension.
- [About](https://www.soulintension.com/about): the story and posture behind the ministry.
- [Community](https://www.soulintension.com/community): the mid-week gathering in Sonoma County.
- [Resources](https://www.soulintension.com/resources): books, organizations, courses, and events on faith and sexuality.
- [Connect](https://www.soulintension.com/connect): how to reach out, attend, or request a conversation.
